scripts.dev: npm run build && docker compose up --build
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.debug: npm run build && docker compose --profile debug up -d --build --force-recreate --wait db-debug debug && docker compose exec debug php scripts/local-seed-public.php
scripts.debug:stop: docker compose --profile debug stop db-debug debug
scripts.local:setup: docker compose build web && node scripts/php.mjs scripts/local-init.php
